_: Team radio lines: id -> [who, text] (e = race engineer, d = driver). The numbered ids and their speakers are those game.js already calls; the wording follows the F1 team radio archive at formuladream.app (39,537 clips, 2018-2026, read 2026-10-11): short turns, okay/so/copy openers, repeated calls (box, box), P-numbers and lap times read as seconds and tenths (the minute left out). x01-x11: the grid radio check, DRS back, the green flag, the VSC ending, giving a place back, retiring, pole, the push lap, the cool-down lap, the pit limiter. {placeholders} are filled in by the game; their words are the files <id>_a, <id>_b ... and the values are read out with n0-n59 / oh / point. tools/radio-voices.ps1 makes sounds/radio/*.mp3 and voices.json.
